components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: High-contrast Signal Crimson button for primary create/submit actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add New Space</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 9px 16px; min-height: 38px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #D90410; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B8030D; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D90410; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Nav Rail Item (Active)
components.description: Dark Harbor Navy navigation item with right crimson dot indicator.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; background: #14243D; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #EF010C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #EF010C; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: Hairline-bordered paper input with high-contrast placeholder and focus ring.

components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #C9C5B9; border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px 12px; min-height: 38px; color: #0B1628; caret-color: #D90410; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; outline: none; transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5A6678; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0B1628; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11,22,40,0.28); }

narrative.overview:
Parkly's interface pairs a sunlit warm-limestone operational canvas (#F7F6F2) and crisp paper work cards (#FFFFFF) with a committed deep Harbor Navy navigation shell (#0B1628) and Parkly Signal Crimson primary actions (#D90410 CTA, #EF010C pin mark). Every view is built for rapid outdoor and booth-lit scanning by Chennai parking hosts checking bay capacity, INR tariffs, AI onboarding audits, and reservations.

Depth comes from 1px architectural hairlines (#DFDDD4) and crisp tabular numerals (JetBrains Mono / Manrope) rather than blurred shadows or decorative chrome. Emoji glyphs are banned across controls, status tags, and headings in favor of a single unified 1.75px vector icon set.
keyCharacteristics: Warm limestone daylight canvas anchored by a fixed 248px dark Harbor Navy navigation rail.
Self-hosted Manrope (with dedicated U+20B9 Rupee glyph subsets) paired with JetBrains Mono tabular figures for INR settlements, TN plates, and bay percentages.
Accessible WCAG AA text, placeholder (#5A6678), and signal-button (#D90410) contrast.
Zero browser alert/confirm/prompt interruptions; every confirmation renders inside focus-restoring Escape-dismissible dialogs.

rules.name: The Restrained Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve Signal Crimson exclusively for primary commitments, active navigation dots, and critical errors so high-priority controls stand out immediately against Limestone Paper and Harbor Navy.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Set every INR amount, percentage, slot count, booking ID, and Indian license plate with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (and --font-mono where aligned in columns) so values align vertically across rows.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Convey containment via crisp 1px borders and clean #F1EFE9 / #FFFFFF tonal steps; never wrap rest cards in wide dark glow shadows or 3px accent borders.

dos: Do use self-hosted .woff2 Manrope + JetBrains Mono assets under /fonts/ so strict 'self' Nginx CSP headers never break font loading.
Do route every dialog through the shared Modal wrapper with Escape closing, backdrop click, and trigger focus restoration.
Do represent status via crisp badges paired with semantic contrast and 1.75px vector icons.
donts: Don't place kicker/eyebrow labels above h1 page titles or skip h2 heading levels inside cards.
Don't use Unicode emojis anywhere in navigation, stat icons, chips, buttons, or empty states.
Don't add border-left: 3px active bars on navigation items or call browser alert/confirm/prompt.
